name: MajlisAlpha UAE Ownership Pulse Monitor
purpose: Track UAE ownership signals from official disclosures so major-holder movement, government-linked ownership, free float, foreign-ownership room, insider activity, and strategic stake changes become source-backed research inputs.
ownershipPolicy: No ownership claim should be used in a brief unless holder name, stake level, effective date, official URL, source route, owner, and reviewer status are captured.
workflow: capture ownership signal from official source
classify holder category and change direction
record stake level, effective date, and official URL
assess free-float, foreign-room, governance, or liquidity impact
route material signal to alert, portfolio, peer, quality, claim trace, or compliance workflow
mark ownership claim usable only after reviewer approval

escalationRules.condition: major holder stake changes by a material amount
escalationRules.action: route to Disclosure Alert Watchtower and Claim Trace Inspector

escalationRules.condition: foreign ownership room or free float changes materially
escalationRules.action: send to Peer Benchmark Matrix and Portfolio Risk Radar

escalationRules.condition: insider, director, executive, or related-party holding changes
escalationRules.action: send to Compliance Audit Center before customer-facing export

escalationRules.condition: official URL, holder name, stake percent, or effective date is missing
escalationRules.action: mark blocked and assign Source Refresh Scheduler owner

escalationRules.condition: ownership signal changes valuation, governance, liquidity, or risk language
escalationRules.action: open Answer Quality Lab review before export

launchGate.readyRule: Ownership Pulse Monitor is pilot-ready when every material ownership signal has holder identity, stake level, effective date, official URL, ticker, research impact, owner, and reviewer status.
launchGate.blockedRule: If an ownership claim is missing source path, holder identity, stake level, or effective date, it cannot support an exported brief.
